title: Korean court keeps Coupang’s record data breach fine in force, delays corrective action plan for 30 days
content_md: There’s yet another update in the Coupang data breach case. Previous coverage on DataBreaches.net of the incident, enforcement actions, and Coupang’s objections to the fines and enforcement actions can be found in links under this update. Now Jeong Hye-Jeong reports: A Seoul court on Thursday rejected Coupang’s request to suspend a 423.6 billion won ($315.6 million) fine… Article Link: https://databreaches.net/2026/11/05/korean-court-keeps-coupangs-record-data-breach-fine-in-force-delays-corrective-action-plan-for-30-days/
